real_findings_observed.note: genuine pre-existing ruff findings (F601, S110, PLW1510, etc.) in ultrajson's own real test suite -- repo-wide, not within either natural PR's actual changed files (decode.c/encode.c, which ruff doesn't analyze)

controlled_cases_static_contribution: 0 of 8 controlled bugs (all self-authored new files) were independently caught by ruff/semgrep -- expected, since the planted bugs (inverted comparison, off-by-one, credential logging, memory leak, data race, use-after-move, cross-file contract violations) are semantic/logic bugs outside these linters' pattern-matching scope; this is exactly the class of bug PatchFrog's AI review layer exists to catch on top of static analysis, not a static-analyzer gap.
overlap_with_ai: not measurable this sprint -- AI findings came exclusively from a scripted oracle (no live model), so a real static/AI overlap matrix (as Phase 8's benchmark_baseline already reports for the existing 74-case corpus) could not be produced here without re-deriving Phase 8's own evidence.
